mapper.select: /*selectMasterMpSoDlvyAgrmntHistoryManagePopList*/ SELECT DISTINCT A.PR_NO , B.PO_NO , F_GET_CMCD_NAME('C020', B.HIST_RSN_CD) AS HIST_RSN , REPLACE(B.HIST_RSN_MEMO, '^^', CHR(13)||CHR(10) ) AS HIST_RSN_MEMO , B.HIST_DTTM , B.PROC_USER_ID , A.HIST_ID FROM ICOMPODT_HIST A , ICOMPOHD_HIST B WHERE A.BUYER = B.BUYER AND A.PO_NO = B.PO_NO AND A.HIST_ID = B.HIST_ID AND A.BUYER = #{st_buyer} AND A.PR_NO IN (SELECT PR_NO FROM ICOMPODT WHERE BUYER = #{st_buyer} AND PO_NO = #{st_po_no} ) ORDER BY B.HIST_DTTM DESC
